Question: I am from Rawalpindi, i need confirmation about Prize Bond ( In Pakistan ), Is Prize Bond halal or not, Please guide me about this (with explanation) Thanks! Answer ID: 12949 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 907/847=B/1430) Prize bond is a kind of gambling ( qimar ); therefore it is unlawful and haram . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
